title: Build a RAG Retriever
summary: Build the retrieval half of retrieval-augmented generation: chunk documents with overlap, embed them with a hashed bag of words, rank chunks by cosine similarity, and pack the best ones into a cited prompt that respects a context budget.

NaNInSoftmax.hint: A NaN in the similarity scores comes from dividing by a zero norm. Return 0 for empty vectors instead of dividing.

hints.test_chunk_text_windows: words = text.split(); step = size − overlap; take words[start:start + size] for start in range(0, len(words), step), and stop after the window that reaches the end. Validate size and overlap first.
hints.test_chunk_overlap_is_exact: The next window starts at start + (size − overlap). Using size − overlap ± 1 makes neighbours share one word too many or too few.
hints.test_embed_matches_spec: Count tokenize(text) into v[bucket(tok, dim)], then divide by np.linalg.norm(v), but only if the norm is > 0.
hints.test_cosine_similarity_normalizes: A raw dot product rewards long vectors. Divide M @ q by ‖row‖·‖q‖, and return 0 wherever that product is 0.
hints.test_top_k_order_and_ties: Sort indices by the key (−score, index). np.argsort(-scores) isn't stable by default, so ties can come out in either order.
hints.test_index_search_finds_relevant_chunk: add_document should chunk_text the document and add() every chunk under the same source. search embeds the query, scores every stored vector and keeps top_k.
hints.test_index_ties_keep_insertion_order: Ids are positions in insertion order (0, 1, 2, …). Equal scores must come back in that order, which a stable top_k gives you.
hints.test_build_prompt_format: Each line is f"[{n}] ({source}) {text}", numbered from 1 in rank order. Copy the header, 'Context:', 'Question:' and 'Answer:' lines from task.md exactly.
hints.test_build_prompt_respects_budget: Count the newline that joins a line to the previous one: adding line n costs len(line) + 1 except for the first. Stop at the first chunk that doesn't fit.
